justification: Nothing changes this week, and that's not me being lazy, that's me not panicking. Murray's the guy under center, Javonte and Chase Brown are doing the dirty work every Sunday so they keep their jobs, Bernard and Cooper stay out wide, LaPorta stays at tight end over the kid in Cleveland because he suited up and produced in our last loss and I don't churn a chair over four-tenths of a point. Breece Hall's got a Questionable next to his name and he's starting anyway — a guy who plays hurt is worth more to me than Coleman sitting clean and rested on my bench, that's not a projection, that's respect. Kicker and defense ride as-is, I don't think about kickers, nobody does. And to the people in that rag trying to get a rise out of me about my family's scoring — I already said what I had to say about that, and I don't need to say it twice.
